As our next Technical Project Manager in the Data & Migrations team, you will contribute to solving meaningful challenges across the life sciences industry. We offer specialised management consulting services, working with top-tier life sciences companies as well as biotech startups — locally and globally. From strategy development to hands-on implementation, we support our clients were impact matters most

About the role

This is a Senior role designed to provide program leadership to deliver strategic technical solutions that address complex client issues in the Life Sciences industry. As a manager within the Migration team, you will be handling projects and programs with regards to migration implementation to achieve desired outcomes and ensure successful business growth and regulatory compliance. You will also seek new business opportunities to help BASE life science grow its presence within existing and new customers.

You will provide program/project management oversight for all customer implementations falling under the Migrations team’s scope.

You will lead project teams consisting of data engineers/scientists. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in data engineering, project management and the ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications.

As a Technical Project Manager for the Migration team your responsibilities include:

• Monitoring program status including milestones, risks, issues, budgets, etc.

• Acting as a delivery escalation point and proactively ensuring escalations are handled promptly with a clear action and communication plan.

• Providing executive level summaries for senior executives in BASE life science.

• Intervening, when necessary, to ensure costs, timelines and quality are on track.

• Developed plans and effort estimates for future project during sales process.

Delivering Projects:

• Lead a cross-functional team to deliver data driven projects on time, within budget, and to the satisfaction of our life science industry stakeholders.

• Collaborate with business stakeholders in the life science industry to understand their data needs and translate them into technical specifications for the project team.

• Develop project plans, timelines, and budgets for the projects.

• Track and report on project progress, identifying and mitigating risks as needed.

• Facilitate communication and collaboration between the project team, life science industry stakeholders, and other teams within BASE life science.

What makes you the best person for this job?

• 5+ years of experience as a technical project manager ideally within the life science industry or other regulated areas.

• Successful track record of managing technically complex projects such as software development, implementation of IT systems, data migrations, etc.

• Experience leading developers, data engineers and/or data scientists and delivering data driven projects.

• Experience with project management tools such as JIRA.

• Experience with Agile project management methodologies such as SAFe.

• Strong communication skills, both in writing, meetings and in presentations.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

• A genuine interest in understanding the technical aspects of complex data-driven projects.

Additionally, the ideal candidate has the following qualifications:

• Experience with coding in Python, VBA, Java, R, SQL, C, or similar.

• Experience selling either projects or products to clients.

• Experience working with Veeva Vault.

This position is offered in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Who is BASE life science?

Founded in 2007, BASE life science is a business and technology consulting enterprise working exclusively in the life sciences industry.

With headquarters in Denmark and offices across Europe and the United States, we support clients globally. We work closely with our customers to identify, develop, and implement initiatives that drive growth, efficiency, and meaningful change. Through partnerships with leading solution providers such as Veeva, Salesforce, IQVIA, Benchling, and MediSpend, we help our clients unlock the full potential of modern technologies.

Why join BASE Life Science?

At BASE, you work on meaningful, complex challenges at the intersection of technology, science, and business. We trust our people with real responsibility and support them in turning ambition into impact.

You will be part of a collaborative, high‑performing environment where:

• Ambition is encouraged through ownership and continuous learning

• Execution matters — we focus on delivering solutions that work in practice

• Team spirit and trust guide collaboration across roles, countries, and disciplines

• Openness means your ideas are heard, you are challenged constructively, and supported as you grow

Alongside this, we offer:

• Support for health and wellbeing, covering physical, mental, and social needs

• Flexible ways of working, built on trust, autonomy, and balance

• Ongoing learning and professional development throughout your career

• A modern work setup, with the tools and equipment needed to do great work

• Recognition of performance and impact, linked to contribution and results

• The opportunity to work on challenges that make a meaningful difference for patients and healthcare systems worldwide

Explore our work, values, and people at www.baselifescience.com

Interested?

If you find this position intriguing, don't delay—submit your application in English at your earliest convenience. We are continuously reviewing and assessing all incoming candidates and eagerly await your application.

At BASE Life Science, we value diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Employment decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs

By submitting your application, you consent to the processing of your personal data by BASE life science for the purposes of recruitment and selection. This includes the collection, storage, and use of your personal data as outlined in our Privacy Policy.

Introduction

We are looking for a talented Field Service Engineer based in Ballerup, Denmark or in Southern Germany. The ideal candidate has a minimum of 7 years of experience in servicing and maintaining scientific, analytical, biomedical, or laboratory equipment**.**

About the Role

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Field Service Engineer to join Sophion Bioscience’s small, dedicated service team.

You will work alongside curious, hands-on colleagues who solve problems, share knowledge, and support one another - even when working independently in the field.

The team values high-quality work, clear communication, and a straightforward, respectful customer experience. In this key role, you will ensure the reliable performance of our automated patch clamp and organ-on-a-chip instruments at customer sites. Your responsibilities will include troubleshooting, maintenance and repairs, system evaluations, customer training, and coordinating upgrades with cross-functional teams.

As an ambassador for Sophion, you will build strong customer relationships by communicating effectively and resolving technical issues promptly, helping drive the continued growth of Sophion Bioscience.

About Us

Since 2000 Sophion Bioscience has pioneered Automated Patch Clamping for ion channel research. Today, we specialize in automated solutions for pre-clinical life sciences.

We work closely with academic institutions, contract research organizations, and leading biotech and pharmaceutical companies to create effective assays for screening and characterization. Our solutions empower the study of drug targets and candidates at the bench, reducing development time in discovery and reducing risk in clinical trials.

Through the continued development of our Automated Patch Clamp portfolio (QPatch & Qube) and our new Organ On a Chip platform (Ethica), we offer uncompromised data quality in a user-friendly environment, from assay setup to advanced data analysis.

We are driven by curiosity, teamwork, and a genuine passion for helping scientists succeed. We work in an open and collaborative environment where people share knowledge freely, support each other across roles and borders, and take pride in doing things properly. Our culture is informal, trusting, and grounded in respect — for colleagues, customers, and the science we enable. Even as we grow globally, we remain a company where people feel welcome, included, and able to make a meaningful impact.

We are headquartered in Denmark and have subsidiaries in the United States, Japan, and China.

What You'll Do

• Installation and Commissioning: Conducting on-site installation and commissioning of Sophion Automated Patch Clamp and Ethica M instrumentation, ensuring it meets the client's specifications and quality standards.

• Maintenance and Repairs: Performing routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs of QPatch, Qube and Ethica M systems to ensure uninterrupted functionality. Responding promptly to service requests and providing timely resolutions.

• Documentation: Creating detailed service reports, documentation, and maintaining accurate records of all service activities. Providing feedback to the engineering and R&D teams for continuous product improvement.

• Training: Providing training to clients on the proper usage, maintenance, and troubleshooting of Sophion automated patch clamp & Ethica M instrumentation, ensuring they have a clear understanding of its features and capabilities.

• Customer Support: Serving as a point of contact for technical support, addressing client inquiries, and maintaining strong relationships with customers to enhance satisfaction.

• Collaboration: Collaborating with the Sales, Application Science and Engineering teams to communicate client feedback, potential product enhancements, and identify opportunities for upselling additional services or products.

Who You Are

You are an experienced service professional with a passion for customer success, technical excellence, and being a team player. You thrive in a hands-on environment where no two days are the same and enjoy executing your day-to-day responsibilities in close collaboration with the rest of the Sophion team.

We imagine that you:

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Biomedical Engineering, a related field or equivalent certifications

• In-depth knowledge of liquid handling devices from various industry systems is a benefit.

• Experience with electrical and pneumatics preferred

• Must possess a good grasp of core engineering concepts which include the ability to read and interpret electrical/circuit Schematic drawings.

• Able to use test/measuring equipment like Digital Multimeter (DVM).

• Team player, critical thinker, and flexible for effective performance in the field.

• Experience with service management systems and processes

• Familiarity with the operation and maintenance of Festo pressure systems is a plus

• Manage MySQL and Oracle databases to ensure seamless system integration and performance.

• Network Configuration and Maintenance: configure and troubleshoot network setups, routers, and DHCP configurations to guarantee optimal system connectivity.

• Possess a basic understanding of Linux systems to address software and operating system-related challenges.

• Demonstrate excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities to address technical issues promptly.

• Communicate effectively with customers and colleagues, ensuring a positive and collaborative working place.

• Ability to travel 50-60% once initial training is complete.

How to Apply

Please apply via LinkedIn.

If you have questions about the role, you are welcome to contact the HR Director, Helene Fife, (+45 51 20 34 43).

Start Date

As soon as possible.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and close the recruitment process once we have found the right candidate. If this opportunity excites you, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Do you want a broad accounting role with significant responsibility and excellent development opportunities?

If you are an experienced accounting professional who enjoys taking ownership, working independently, and being part of a collaborative team, this could be exactly the opportunity you have been looking for.

At Gubra, we are experiencing continued growth and development. As our business expands, so do the opportunities for our employees to develop professionally and take on increasing responsibility. We are therefore looking for a Financial Accountant to join our Finance team and contribute to maintaining a high level of quality, compliance, and operational excellence across our group companies.

In this role, you will become part of our finance function where teamwork, trust, and continuous improvement are highly valued.

A broad accounting role with responsibility across multiple areas

As Financial Accountant, you will be responsible for a variety of accounting and controlling activities spanning day-to-day bookkeeping, reconciliations, month-end closing activities, reporting support, and audit preparation.

You will have ownership of your own areas while working closely with your colleagues in Finance. We take pride in supporting one another and working together to ensure successful month-end closings, reporting deadlines, audits, and daily operations.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Managing accounts receivable, including invoicing, cash registrations, reminders, and communication with customers' finance departments

• Maintaining and managing the fixed asset register, including verification of physical assets and correct accounting treatment

• Handling lease accounting in accordance with IFRS 16

• Performing foreign currency revaluations on currency accounts

• Acting as system owner for Corpay, PLEO, and e-conomic

• Preparing statutory and regulatory reporting, including submissions to Statistics Denmark and other authorities

• Supporting colleagues with accounting- and finance-related questions

• Participating in month-end closing activities, reconciliations, and audit preparation

• Contributing to process improvements, internal controls, and finance-related projects

• Supporting ad hoc tasks across the group's legal entities

As you grow in the role, you will have the opportunity to expand your responsibilities and actively influence how we develop our finance processes and controls.

An experienced accounting professional with a proactive mindset

Naturally, we are looking for someone with the right professional qualifications. However, your approach to work and collaboration is equally important.

We are looking for someone who takes ownership, follows through on commitments, and enjoys working in an environment that combines structured routines with changing priorities and deadlines.

In addition, you bring:

• You likely have 5+ years of experience from a finance function where you have worked independently with bookkeeping, reconciliations, month-end closing, and financial controls.

• Strong Excel skills and experience with financial systems

• A structured and detail-oriented approach to your work

• The ability to work independently and take responsibility for your areas

• A positive and collaborative mindset with a willingness to support colleagues across the organization

• Professional communication skills in both Danish and English, written and spoken

Experience from an international company with entities in multiple countries is considered an advantage, but not a requirement. Likewise, experience with Corpay, PLEO, and/or e-conomic is beneficial but not essential.

We are particularly interested in someone who is curious and analytical. You notice when something does not look right, investigate the underlying cause, and work proactively to find a solution rather than simply reporting the deviation.

Your new team

You will join a Finance team consisting of four colleagues, including yourself. We work closely together, share knowledge, and support one another in delivering high-quality financial operations.

The role can be structured as either a full-time or part-time position (32-37 hours per week), depending on your preferences and qualifications.

We look forward to welcoming a colleague who enjoys being part of a team while maintaining ownership of their own responsibilities.

What we offer

• A broad and independent role in a collaborative Finance team

• A full-time or part-time position (32-37 hours per week)

• Real responsibility and ownership from day one

• The opportunity to influence processes, workflows, and internal controls

• Flexible working arrangements, including the possibility of working from home

• Ongoing opportunities to develop your role and responsibilities

• An informal and positive working environment

• Dedicated colleagues and a strong team spirit

• Competitive salary based on qualifications

• Pension scheme and health insurance

• Start date as soon as possible, although we are happy to wait for the right candidate

About Gubra

Gubra is a disease-agnostic techbio company specialized in peptide-based drug discovery and development as well as preclinical contract research services striving for excellence at all levels. We insist on doing things efficiently - and often differently - to reach the results we aim for. Our vision is to become leaders in the path towards a more sustainable and healthier world. We do that by facilitating the discovery of new medicine, and by acting and inspiring others to fight the ongoing climate and biodiversity crises.

Gubra’s activities are focused on the early stages of drug development and are organised in two main highly synergistic business areas: Biotech and CRO Services. We generate our revenue by performing research for life science companies as well as by partnering projects from our discovery and development pipeline.

Our therapeutic focus is within metabolic and fibrotic diseases, and we specialize in in vivo pharmacology, ex vivo assays, drug profiling, histology, stereology and whole brain and organ imaging. In addition, we offer a full palette of advanced transcriptomics. Our ML/AI-driven peptide drug discovery platform streaMLine enables us to rapidly develop a peptide hit into a non-clinical candidate ready for development. Through a constant focus on high quality, scientific excellence, speed, and solid teamwork we have established ourselves as a highly professional and competent partner in the market.

People are our greatest asset, and our team consists of around 320 employees of which many are located in Hørsholm, Denmark. The mix of people from different cultures and educational backgrounds combined with our entrepreneurial mindset have greatly impacted our working environment, which is characterized by entrepreneurial drive, scientific curiosity, and teamwork – we join forces!

Are you structured, service-minded and good at keeping track of the details? Do you enjoy coordinating people, processes and customers – and making sure that things run smoothly?

At Axlab, we are an ambitious and growing international company. In collaboration with Actief Hartmanns, we are looking for a Service Coordinator to join our team and play a central role in coordinating service activities, managing service contracts and supporting our customers, service teams and external partners.

This is a role for someone who enjoys being the person who keeps things moving. You will have a broad range of contacts across the organization and will act as an important link between customers, Sales, Service, external service providers and other internal stakeholders.

Who are we

With our vision “Your Vision. Our Inspiration” we create real impact by implementing innovation that matters and creating tomorrow’s pathology labs. Axlab distributes and supplies advanced medical equipment and consumables with a focus on pathology to laboratories and hospitals primarily in Europe and the USA. Currently, Axlab distributes products from 21 suppliers, many of which are important strategic partners. We are approximately 70 colleagues, with more than half located at our headquarters in Vedbæk. The remaining colleagues are engaged in sales and sales enablement across Europe and the USA

The role

As Service Coordinator, you will be responsible for the administration and coordination of service activities throughout the customer and contract lifecycle.

You will work closely with both internal and external stakeholders to ensure that service agreements are correctly established and maintained, service requests are followed up, and customers receive professional and timely support.

You will also be responsible for our FSM (Field Service Management) system and will play an important role in ensuring that service-related information and processes are accurate, structured and up to date.

Your key responsibilities

• 
Manage and maintain customer service contracts in the ERP/FSM system, ensuring accuracy, completeness and timely activation, including renewals, amendments, SLAs and contractual obligations.

• 
Take responsibility for the FSM software and ensure accurate and efficient service administration.

• 
Coordinate service activities between customers, internal service teams and third-party service providers, including scheduling, follow-up and documentation.

• 
Act as the primary contact for external service partners, monitor performance against agreed service levels and contractual obligations, and resolve operational issues when required.

• 
Provide professional customer support and timely follow-up on service requests and inquiries.

• 
Support Sales and Service with contract-related documentation and administration.

• 
Coordinate service training activities.

• 
Identify opportunities to improve service coordination and administrative workflows, support best-practice implementation and ensure compliance with company procedures and quality standards.

What you bring

You have experience from a service-oriented administrative or coordinating role and enjoy working in an environment where you need to balance structure, customer service and multiple priorities.

We imagine that you have:

• 
Relevant education or training within administration, customer service, service coordination or a related field.

• 
Experience with service coordination, customer service, contract administration or a similar role.

• 
Experience working with ERP, CRM or service management systems.

• 
Good knowledge of Microsoft Office 365.

• 
Excellent written and spoken English.

More importantly, you are a person who takes ownership and follows things through. You are highly organized, structured and detail-oriented, while still being able to see the bigger picture.

You are proactive and solution-oriented, and you enjoy finding practical solutions when things do not go according to plan. You communicate clearly and build good relationships with customers, colleagues and external partners.

You are comfortable working independently, but you also enjoy being part of a team and collaborating across departments and cultures.

What we offer

We are a small yet ambitious growth company where our shared values — Decency, Innovation, Commitment, and Responsibility — form the foundation of everything we do.

We offer a flexible, hybrid, and trust-based full-time position where you will have influence on both your own role and the continued development of our Service & Customer IT function. Occasional travel activity must be expected as part of the role.

• 
Competitive salary and employment conditions

• 
A highly visible role with direct access to senior leadership

• 
Influence on business decisions and strategic initiatives

• 
Professional and personal development opportunities

• 
An international and collaborative working environment

• 
Modern offices in Vedbæk

• 
Lunch scheme

• 
Free fruit and refreshments

• 
Social activities and annual global events

Join our Science-Driven Drug Development Organization as a Clinical Data Management Associate or Clinical Data Manager

Are you a recent graduate, an experienced clinical data management professional, or considering a career change? Do you have a passion for data and enjoy working collaboratively to solve complex challenges? If clinical trials excite you, you might be the perfect fit for our global research organization dedicated to first-class clinical research.

We welcome applications from both emerging and experienced candidates with an interest in clinical data management. The position will be tailored to the successful candidate's qualifications, experience, and competencies, with role as either a Clinical Data Management Associate or a Clinical Data Manager.

Our team excels at onboarding new members, ensuring you won't get lost in the crowd and will grow with us. Join an environment driven by dedication and positivity, where you can make a meaningful impact and expand your skills across all aspects of drug development.

Who are we?

Sanos is a global multi-niche Clinical Research Organization (CRO) with full-circle clinical capabilities. We specialize in three main areas: Neurological Disorders (NeuroScios), Dermatological Conditions (Blueskin), and Musculoskeletal and Related Disorders (NBCD). Our core expertise lies in Science, Medical, and Clinical Operational functions.

Sanos is committed to delivering high-quality clinical trials and innovative solutions, supported by a robust organizational structure and a focus on specialization. Our brands include NBCD, Blueskin, NeuroScios, and Sanos Clinic.

Join us as we continue to strengthen our position as a leader in clinical research and development. As our organization is growing, we are now looking for a new colleague.

About the position

Sanos Data Management plays a central role in delivering high-quality clinical trial data. Our work spans the entire clinical trial lifecycle, from designing electronic data collection systems and supporting cross-functional study teams during trial conduct, to programmatically diving into clinical data being collected, to identify trends, ensure data consistency, and support participant safety. Ultimately, we deliver clean, reliable clinical databases ready for statistical analysis, regulatory submission, and market approval.

We are looking for a new colleague to join our team as either a Clinical Data Management Associate or Clinical Data Manager. The final role and level of responsibility will be determined based on the candidate's experience, qualifications, and professional background. As part of our team, you will contribute to the planning, execution, and oversight of clinical data management activities across a variety of clinical trials. Depending on your experience and qualifications, you will either support experienced Clinical Data Managers or take increasing responsibility for data management activities and study oversight within assigned clinical trials. Your responsibilities may include:

• Designing and maintaining electronic data collection systems (EDC)

• Programming data review checks and analyses in SAS to support data quality and participant safety

• Reviewing clinical data and data listings to identify inconsistencies, trends, and potential issues

• Collaborating closely with clinical operations, statistics, medical teams, and study sites

• Managing data queries and facilitating timely data corrections

• Contributing to database lock activities and the delivery of high-quality clinical trial databases

Whether joining as an Associate or a Data Manager, you will have the opportunity to further develop your technical expertise in clinical data management while strengthening your communication, collaboration, and project management skills in a dynamic clinical research environment. In short, you get to be part of our team’s efforts in delivering world-class clinical databases for advancing our clients’ drug development objectives and for authority submission and market approval.

Desired skills and experience

Preferably you have:

• An educational background in the areas of Health and Medical Sciences, Natural Sciences, or other relevant Health or Science education.

• Experience working with data, databases, or data analysis through previous employment, research, or academic projects.

• Clinical data management experience is an advantage but not required for candidates applying at the Associate level.

• Programming experience in SAS, but experience in other programming languages is also an advantage.

• Experience with or knowledge of electronic data capture (EDC) systems used in clinical research.

• General knowledge of clinical trials and clinical research processes.

• For candidates applying at the Clinical Data Manager level, prior responsibility for data management activities within clinical studies will be considered an advantage.

Sanos is committed to supporting professional development. For new hires without prior experience in data management, we will provide the support and training needed to become well-equipped to handle the job requirements, while experienced professionals will have opportunities for continued growth and increasing responsibility.

Personal profile

We believe candidates with the following qualities will thrive in the role and fit well within our culture.

• Structured and knows the importance of following timelines, procedures, and prioritizing tasks

• Analytical mindset and enjoys logical problem solving

• Responsible and can work independently and assume accountability of your delegated responsibilities while also being a team player who understands that we deliver as a team

• Curious, eager to learn, and able to quickly acquire new knowledge and skills.

• Strong communication skills and proficient in business English (spoken and written).

• You are detail-oriented and motivated by delivering high-quality work.

Are we the right cultural fit?

Our commitment to you is encapsulated in our promise to every one of our employees saying, ‘Trust in you – in your development and impact’.

This pledge extends uniformly across all entities within the Sanos organization, ensuring that you feel its effects from the very outset of your interaction.

If you are curious about whether you would thrive within the Sanos culture and the Sanos way of leading, reflect on whether you see yourself working within our principles:

Take on - Responsibility is given, and we inspire you to take it

Try out - Explore diverse tasks and grow professionally

Team up - We don’t just work together; we thrive together

Want to know more? Check out the Voice of Sanos Group people here.

Apply and make a real impact

We are eager to hear from you! Please submit your CV and application through the "apply" link.

We are conducting interviews from the beginning of October and will close the position when we find the right candidate.

If you need further information about the role, please contact Associate Director, Data Management; Kamilla Mundbjerg at kam@sanos.com or Lead Clinical Data Manager, Ema Erkocevic Petersen at eep@sanos.com.

This is a full-time position. The work location is Telefonvej 8D, 2860 Søborg.

Physical presence at our office on a weekly basis is our preference but we are also open to hybrid solutions should this be more suitable for the successful candidate.

Travel: Limited travel activity is to be expected.

If you proceed in the recruitment process, you will go through a few additional steps where both you and we will assess whether this position is the right match for both parties. As part of the recruitment process, we use assessments to ensure the optimal match and the best foundation for future collaboration

Sanos is dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives leads to better decision-making and innovation. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive.

About Enduro Genetics

Enduro Genetics is a Copenhagen-based synthetic biology company commercializing Enduro Sense™, a genetic platform that increases the productivity of production hosts and cell lines in existing and new recombinant biomanufacturing processes. Enduro Sense™ links production to cellular fitness, so cells increase their production, stay productive over longer runs and at larger scale.

Enduro Sense™ has been deployed and demonstrated for more than 20 bioproducts, from industrial enzymes and food proteins to pharmaceutical peptides and biologics.

Why join us

In a 25-person company, your work will be visible and your results will shape how we grow. You will be part of our commercial team, working closely with leadership and our client delivery team. We offer a competitive salary package, including bonus. If you are results-driven and want to bring a proven new technology to biomanufacturers, we'd like to hear from you.

The role

You will lead market mapping, prospecting and lead qualification across biopharma, CDMOs and bioindustrial companies. You will identify the decision-makers, start conversations, assess technical and commercial fit, and advance promising opportunities with our client delivery team.

You'll join with the groundwork in place: an established CRM, market databases and sales tools, an active pipeline, and ongoing dialogues with prospective customers.

What you'll do

• Continued market mapping of applications, target companies and decision-makers to set prospecting priorities.

• Run outbound prospecting, and handle and prioritize incoming leads.

• Conduct initial discovery and pitch meetings, establishing customer needs, technical fit and next steps.

• Represent Enduro at conferences and events, and follow up with relevant contacts.

• Develop and tailor pitch decks, case studies and other customer-facing materials.

• Coordinate customer proposals with the client delivery team, including the customer-facing narrative, scope, deliverables and timelines.

What you bring

• A scientific background in biotechnology, molecular biology, bioprocessing or a related field, ideally at MSc or PhD level.

• Around 3–5 years of experience in business development, technical sales or another customer-facing role in biotechnology, biomanufacturing, CDMO services, genetics or similar platform technologies.

• Experience in selling, qualifying opportunities, presenting technical solutions and contributing to sales proposals.

• Outgoing, sound commercial judgement and a disciplined approach to sales. .

• Fluent English. Danish is an advantage.

Experience with microbial or CHO production systems, an established industry network or complex deal negotiations is a plus.

You're self-driven, curious about the science behind what you sell, and comfortable introducing a new approach to experienced technical audiences.

Practical details

• Location: Copenhagen, on-site

• Compensation: Competitive salary package, including bonus

• Travel: Expect travel for conferences and client visits.

Interested? Apply here https://EnduroGenetics.reqruiting.com/job.aspx?id=29680 . We review applications on a rolling basis.

Picture your typical week: on Monday you’re on-site at a client, driving a project team through a critical phase of an IT/OT implementation. By Wednesday you’re facilitating a workshop across business, IT, and engineering to resolve a key delivery issue. Friday, you’re back at Emendo’s Nordhavn office sharing what you learned and sharpening the methods your colleagues will use on their projects. If that sounds like work you’d love, keep reading.

Why We’re Hiring Now

We paused hiring over the past year to be deliberate about the team we build next. The consulting market in Denmark has tightened, and our clients have changed how they buy: they want consultants who can take real ownership, navigate complexity, and show measurable progress quickly. We are now making a small number of hires — each one matters, and we are taking the time to find the right people.

About Emendo

Emendo is a 200-person consultancy built by people who used to sit on the client side — running transformation programmes inside leading global companies before deciding to do it for a living. We understand the pressure a site director feels before a go-live, we know what an inspector looks for in a regulated environment, and we speak the language of the people who operate the systems we implement. We work across the full Operational value chain from R&D through shipping, with offices in Copenhagen, Kalundborg, Odense, Silkeborg, Munich, and Raleigh (USA). Our strategy is simple: deliver faster, prove value in hard numbers, and use our methods and AI tools to do what we do well — only quicker.

We are a methods-driven firm rooted in operational excellence and Lean. Our motto, Observe, Think, Improve, is itself a method: go to the floor, understand what is actually happening, analyse it rigorously, then design and implement a concrete improvement. That simplicity is what makes it reliable when the project gets complicated and the usual playbooks stop working.

The Role

You will lead projects and workstreams within IT/OT transformation engagements for our clients, mainly in (but not limited to) pharma and regulated industries— operating at the intersection of technology, business process, and organisational change. You are expected to create structure, drive progress, coordinate stakeholders, and make sure decisions turn into action. At Emendo, being a Lead Consultant means taking real ownership while continuing to build the judgement and client credibility required to lead increasingly complex engagements.

What You Will Do

• Lead projects and workstreams on-site, driving IT/OT implementations across enterprise, operations management, process control, and process equipment layers

• Create structure and momentum through clear planning, governance, stakeholder alignment, and follow-up

• Drive measurable progress in short cycles — turning project activity into tangible outcomes

• Coordinate cross-functional teams across business, IT, engineering, vendors, and other stakeholders

• Facilitate workshops, resolve issues, manage dependencies, and turn complex discussions into clear decisions and actions

• Engage with solution architecture, validation concepts, and implementation planning within complex project environments

• Build strong client relationships and become a trusted counterpart who takes ownership and gets things done

• Apply Observe, Think, Improve as your foundation and contribute to strengthening Emendo’s methods and tools

What It Takes

Must-Have Qualifications

• Master’s degree in engineering, IT, business, innovation, or a related discipline

• 2–5+ years of hands-on experience delivering IT/OT projects, digital transformations, or technology implementations — ideally within pharma or another regulated industry

• Experience taking ownership of a project, workstream, or significant delivery area

• Strong project management fundamentals, including planning, governance, risk and issue management, and stakeholder coordination

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to create structure in complex or changing environments

• Confidence working across business and technical stakeholders

• Fluent English, both written and spoken; Danish skills are strongly preferred, or a commitment to learn

• Willingness to work on-site at client locations in Denmark and occasionally internationally

jobs.occupation: Two-year Postdoc position on Spintronic Quantum-inspired Computing
jobs.description:
Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a 2-year Postdoctoral Researcher position within the newly funded QUANTRONIC – Spintronic Pseudo-Qubits for Room-Temperature Quantum Computing project, supported by the Villum Experiment programme of Villum Fonden.

We are seeking a highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to investigate a new class of spintronic pseudo-qubits (p-qubits) based on spin-orbit torque magnetic tunnel junctions (SOT-MTJs). The project explores whether engineered stochastic spintronic devices can reproduce key computational mechanisms associated with quantum systems - including superposition-like states, probability-amplitude-based interference, and entanglement-like correlations—without relying on fragile quantum coherence or cryogenic operation.

QUANTRONIC is a high-risk, high-gain research project positioned at the intersection of spintronics, probabilistic computing, quantum-inspired computing, nanoelectronics, and integrated circuit design. The central concept is a novel SOT-MTJ architecture designed to represent and manipulate probability amplitudes and to enable synchronization between multiple pseudo-qubits. The project will combine physics-based modelling, device design and fabrication, experimental characterization, and system-level demonstrations.

The successful candidate will work within SDU Microelectronics and collaborate closely with international partners, particularly INL – International Iberian Nanotechnology Laboratory, on the design and fabrication of spintronic devices.

The position is expected to start in February 2027, with the specific starting date to be agreed with the successful candidate.

 

As a Postdoctoral Researcher in QUANTRONIC, your key responsibilities will include:

• 
Develop and refine physics-based compact models of SOT-MTJ-based pseudo-qubits, including stochastic switching and inter-device coupling.

• 
Develop Verilog-A models and integrate them into circuit-level simulation environments such as Cadence.

• 
Investigate the physical requirements for controlling probabilistic states and representing probability amplitudes in spintronic devices.

• 
Collaborate with project partners on the design and fabrication of SOT-MTJ devices and arrays.

• 
Experimentally characterize standalone devices and coupled arrays, including stochastic switching, synchronization, and entanglement-like correlations.

• 
Investigate quantum-inspired gate operations and system-level demonstrations using networks of pseudo-qubits.

• 
Contribute to proof-of-concept demonstrations, including integer factorization and other quantum-inspired computational problems.

• 
Publish research results in high-quality international journals and conferences and contribute to the dissemination of project results.

• 
Collaborate with researchers in spintronics, probabilistic computing, microelectronics, materials science, and quantum information.

 

What we offer

• 
A unique opportunity to work on a high-risk, high-gain research concept exploring a new computational regime between classical probabilistic and quantum computing.

• 
A stimulating research environment within SDU Microelectronics, a growing research section with expertise in spintronics, probabilistic computing, neuromorphic computing, analog/digital IC design, and emerging computing architectures.

• 
Access to advanced facilities for electronic design, device characterization, measurement, and system prototyping.

• 
Close collaboration with INL – International Iberian Nanotechnology Laboratory on spintronic device technology and fabrication.

• 
Opportunities to collaborate with national and international researchers in spintronics, quantum-inspired computing, quantum technologies, and nanoelectronics.

• 
An open, international, and collaborative research environment within SDU's Faculty of Engineering, supporting interdisciplinary research across electronics, physics, materials science, and computing.

• 
Strong opportunities for developing an independent research profile in an emerging area of probabilistic and quantum-inspired hardware.

 

What we expect

Applicants should hold a PhD in electronic engineering, electrical engineering, applied physics, nanotechnology, spintronics, or a closely related field.

The ideal candidate should have experience in one or more of the following areas:

• 
Spintronics and magnetic devices, particularly MTJs, STT-MTJs, SOT-MTJs, or related technologies.

• 
Physics-based modelling of nanoscale or magnetic devices.

• 
Verilog-A, SPICE, and Cadence or comparable circuit/device simulation environments.

• 
Experimental characterization of electronic, magnetic, or spintronic devices.

• 
Stochastic or probabilistic computing systems.

Experience in micromagnetic simulation, magnetotransport measurements, nanofabrication, probabilistic computing, or quantum/quantum-inspired computing will be considered a strong advantage.

We are particularly interested in candidates who are enthusiastic about working across traditional disciplinary boundaries and are comfortable combining device physics, modelling, experimentation, and computing concepts.

The successful candidate should be able to work independently while contributing actively to an interdisciplinary and international research team. Excellent written and spoken English and strong communication skills are required.

 

Workplace description 

The successful candidate will join SDU Microelectronics, a dynamic and expanding section at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME). The section conducts internationally recognized research in integrated circuits, spintronics, photonics, and neuromorphic computing, and plays a central role in SDU’s ambition to be a national and European hub for semiconductor and chip innovation. 

 

Further information 

For further information about the position, please contact Professor Farshad Moradi (moradi@sdu.dk / email), Head of the SDU Microelectronics section and Associate Professor Hooman Farkhani (farkhani@sdu.dk / email), Deputy Head of SDU Microelectronics. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

• 
Motivated application.

• 
Curriculum Vitae. 

• 
Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

• 
Complete list of publications.

• 
Publications most relevant to the position.

• 
Summary and documentation of experience in teaching, if relevant to the position. 

• 
A research statement may be included.

• 
References/reference letters may also be included.

• 
A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 10, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 2-year period, and the preferred start date is February 2027. Extension may be possible depending on available funding.

Employment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.
